messages:
riley_docs: opened a compact PR to fix two dashboard links, add a tiny SDK header migration snippet, and a short note on quota label changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 :link:
jas_devex: can you paste the SDK snippet and callouts here? want to quick-check wording before review.
mo_eng: infra note: we normalized the quota label to `quota_tier_id` last sprint (was `tier_id`). recommend advising customers to use a recording rule during overlap.
riley_docs: pasted snippet and checklist inline. kept it short.
```js
// migrate old header X-RW-Limit -> X-RW-Usage (recommended)
fetch('/v1/usage', { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${KEY}`, 'X-RW-Usage': '200000' }});
// helper to translate legacy header
function migrate(h) { if (h['X-RW-Limit']) { h['X-RW-Usage'] = h['X-RW-Limit']; delete h['X-RW-Limit']; } return h; }
```

riley_docs: Checklist added to PR:
- Fix two broken doc links to /dashboards/usage and /pricing/grid.
- Add recording rule example to combine old/new quota label (docs snippet).
- Warn customers not to hardcode legacy headers in long-lived automation.
- Add changelog entry under "Docs" and tag infra for overlap confirmation.
jas_devex: tiny nit: show an example recording rule and a PromQL sample for panels (makes it easier for reviewers). Also mark the compat flag as "managed-only" if we expose one.
mo_eng: confirmed we'll emit both labels for ~21 days; adding a comment on the PR to lock that down. Also we won't expose any compat flag publicly without Gated support flow.
riley_docs: added PromQL example to PR: ```promql
avg_over_time(redwood_quota_tokens_total{project="proj_9"}[1h])
// or use recording rule: redwood_quota_tokens_alias = redwood_quota_tokens_total OR redwood.quota.tokens
```
ci-bot: docs build passed for PR 4789 (lint: 0 warnings).
doc-bot: tagged PR with `rate-limits`,`quotas`,`migration-guides` and bumped TOC.
jas_devex: LGTM once infra confirms exact overlap and we soften wording from "must" to "recommended" in the dashboard paragraph.
riley_docs: changed wording to "recommended" and added ops ticket OPS-912 for redirect scheduling. merging after infra confirms duration. thanks folks :rocket:
